name: bg-falling-stars
title: Falling Stars Background
description: A dark full-bleed starfield drawn on a canvas: small dots in the middle stretch into long white lines as they fly toward the viewer and out past the edges, forever.
use: A dark hero or space-themed page needs a constant sense of speed behind its headline.
avoid: It redraws on every frame forever and is absolutely positioned, so it needs a sized relative parent.
a11y: Decorative canvas with no reduced-motion check and no way to pause the endless outward motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A pure black field filled with short white dashes that radiate from the centre. Near the middle they are tiny specks and near the edges they lengthen into bright streaks. A small white title and dim subtitle sit at the centre.
behaves: Stars push steadily outward from the centre, growing longer as they near the viewer, then wrap back to the middle to start again. The loop never stops and only the resize event restarts the sizing.
customise: color tints the stars and count sets how many there are; className adds styling, while speed, the three blur layers and projection are in the source.
weight: moderate: Two hundred stars drawn with several strokes each, on every animation frame.
